name: Weather
description: Current conditions and forecasts for anywhere in the world, from the Open-Meteo public API. No account and no API key.

capabilities.name: Current weather
capabilities.description: Current temperature, wind, humidity and conditions for a place or coordinates.

capabilities.name: Forecast
capabilities.description: Daily forecast up to 16 days: high, low, precipitation and conditions.

capabilities.name: Find a place
capabilities.description: Resolve a place name to coordinates, country and timezone. Use when a name is ambiguous.

capabilities.name: Reporting weather
capabilities.description: How to answer weather questions well: resolve ambiguous places, respect units, and never state a forecast more precisely than the data supports.
